text:
marta: Heads-up: we've seen a spike in dropped spans for async jobs that retry via SQS. OTLP exporter shows bursts of "errors: ResourceExhausted" and then traces that never reattach. Anyone else?
raj: saw a couple of alerts. is this during a deploy or steady load?
marta: steady load. queue retries + backoff pattern. symptoms: parent span from gateway -> message attribute seems to be missing in the worker after retry.
sam: can you paste the message attributes from the producer and consumer?
marta: producer (gateway) sets these attributes:
```
Attributes: {
  "traceparent": "00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01",
  "x-redwood-request-id": "r-12345",
  "otel-baggage": "tenant=acme"
}
```
raj: on the worker side when the message is pulled after a retry, the attribute list is shorter, traceparent absent. Might be SQS client lib stripping long attributes on redelivery?
lina: FYI SQS has a 256 KB payload limit and attributes limit, but it doesn't drop keys normally. Could be our retry lambda re-publishes without copying attributes.
theo: also seeing exporter backpressure: span exporter queue fills and then OTel SDK starts dropping non-sampled spans. Backend returns 429s in bursts.
raj: two separate but related things: 1) trace context gets lost on retry/republish path, 2) exporter throttles causing local drops. Both increase "lost traces" symptoms.
sam: proposal: attach minimal trace context into the message body as a compact JSON fallback so republish can always preserve it (we currently rely on message attributes only).
lina: +1. body fallback also helps cross-queue hops where attributes may be trimmed by some client.
marta: example minimal payload patch: 
```json
{"_trace":{"traceparent":"00-...","baggage":"tenant=acme"}, "task":{...}}
```
raj: second: make worker reconstruct parent with a link if the original span is unknown, instead of creating an orphan root span. Use SpanContext.fromTraceParent and create SpanKind.CONSUMER with linked span id.
theo: for exporter backpressure: increase SDK internal queue size and switch to batch exporter with smaller timeout, and add a metrics drain loop. But that just masks the root exporter 429s from backend.
sam: can we backpressure at the producer when exporter queue is high? Not trivial for async tasks but maybe slow down non-critical jobs.
lina: also add an internal metric: telemetry.pipeline.span_loss_rate and telemetry.pipeline.exporter_429_rate, plus a dashboard with per-queue aggregation.
marta: can we add a short-lived guard in the gateway: if the outbound message would be > 5 attributes or attributes missing, encode trace into body. keep this behind feature flag.
raj: agree. Implementation checklist: 
- Gateway: fallback body encoding on flag (marta)
- Worker: prefer attributes, fallback to body._trace (theo)
- Worker: when reconstructing, link to original span id (sam)
- Telemetry: new metrics & dashboard (lina)
- Infra: investigate exporter 429 root cause and increase backend capacity or add client-side throttling (raj)

marta: infra-bot: deploy canary for gateway feature-flag to eng-platform-canary?
infra-bot: deploy request received. Canaries: eng-platform-canary. Rolling 2 instances -> 5. ETA ~6m. :rocket:
raj: small UX note: when worker replays and we create a linked span, include attribute `redwood.replay=true` so queries can filter replays.
lina: will add `telemetry.pipeline.replay_link_rate` to dashboard.
theo: quick patch: set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_TIMEOUT=10s and batch_size=200 for SDK in workers, that lowered local drops in my local run.
sam: be careful with lowering timeout; we might accumulate more memory under high throughput. add heap guard.
marta: assigning tasks: I'll own gateway change and can push flag this week. Raj, can you own exporter throttling investigation? Lina will do dashboard. Sam/Theo pair on worker reconstruction.
raj: will start with logs from exporter (span_exporter.retry_count, http_429_count) and correlate with backend time windows.
lina: will add dashboard panels for per-queue span_loss_rate and top producers by request id.
theo: PR incoming for worker lib that reads body._trace and creates linked span. I'll cc sam.
marta: thanks folks. goal: reduce queue-related trace loss by 90% in next 48h. :thumbsup:
sam: ack.
raj: ack.
infra-bot: canary deploy completed for eng-platform-canary. Healthy: 5/5. Logs: no errors in 2m window.
marta: good first sign. I'll follow up once we have dashboard numbers.
